title: Pix-in notification received
description: Internal-only endpoint. This flow is started by our partner's webhook, after successfully cashing in, this event is sent. For more information, see the Pix instant payments guide.

authorization_datetime.title: Authorization Datetime
authorization_datetime.description: Pismo authorization datetime. A RFC 3339 date-time value, i.e., '2023-04-12T23:20:50.52Z'. This field will only be mandatory when the status is SETTLED.

authorization_id.title: Authorization ID
authorization_id.description: Pismo authorization ID, This field will only be mandatory when the status is SETTLED.

end_to_end_id.title: Pix end to end ID
end_to_end_id.description: Pix end to end transaction ID. This field is a Brazil Central Bank (BCB) requirement to track Pix transactions. Basically, there are two steps to a Pix transaction: 1. Initialize a transaction and 2. Confirm a transaction. This field is sent to the BCB in both steps in order to identify all transaction information.

transaction_type.title: Transaction type
transaction_type.description: Type of transaction: `TRANSFER` = simple transfer (purchases or cash only); `CHANGE` = transfer of cash in addition to purchase amount (only when initiated by a `CHANGE` type QR code); `WITHDRAWAL` = cash-only transaction (only when initiated by a `WITHDRAWAL` type QR code); `REFUND_AUTOMATIC_PIX` = refund a pix to the PSP payer  (only when initiated by a `MANUAL`); `REFUND` = total or partial refund to the paying user within the scope of MED 2.0, when this refund occurs from the PI Account of the user's PSP who participated in the distribution chain of the resources of the original transaction (only when initiated by a `MANUAL`); `INSTALLMENT_PIX` = For INSTALLMENT PIX transactions

transaction_identification.title: Transaction identification code
transaction_identification.description: Transaction ID. This field is returned from the Validate QR code endpoint.

account_number.title: Account Number
account_number.description: Pix payer's account number including verifier

bank.title: Bank
bank.description: Pix payer's bank code- ISPB (Identifcador do Sistema de Pagamento Brazil) - the Brazilian Payment System identifier, an 8-digit value.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Pix payer's branch code without digit

document_number.title: Pix payer's document number
document_number.description: Pix payer's federal document number, A government document number, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas number (Brazil). Must be numeric with 11-14 digits.

key.title: Key value
key.description: Key value of key type. For example: email@email.com (`EMAIL` key type)

payer_name.title: Pix-in Payer Name
payer_name.description: Name of payer in Pix-in transaction

payer_participant.title: Payer Participant ID
payer_participant.description: Payer's ISPB (Identifcador do Sistema de Pagamento Brazil) - the Brazilian Payment System identifier for the receiving bank, an 8-digit value.

description.title: Description
description.description: Transaction description shown to the payer so that they can enter relevant information to be sent to the payee.

internal.title: Internal transaction
internal.description: Internal transaction informs if the transaction was made inside Pismo (between accounts at the same Org), in this case, the SPI was not called

error_code.title: Pix In Cancellation Error code
error_code.description: Error code for Pix-in status `CANCELLED`, an 8-digit value.

reason.title: Pix-in Cancellation Reason
examples: Transaction stopped due to error at the Creditor Agent
Creditor account number invalid or missing
Account specified is blocked, prohibiting posting of transactions against it
Creditor account type missing or invalid
Transaction type not supported/authorized on this account
Amount received is not the amount agreed or expected
Identification of end customer is not consistent with associated account number. (formerly CreditorConsistency)
Value in Creditor Identifier is incorrect
The order was rejected by the bank side (for reasons concerning content)
Settlement of the transaction has failed
Cash-in denied due to validation API timeout.
Confirmation time expired for this transaction
Service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
Waiting time expired due to incomplete order.
